description.en: Sets the screen position of a named telop caption created with CMND_2DO_CREATE_TELOP.
Name of the telop to move.
True once it succeeded; false if the named telop isn't ready/found; null if the call itself was invalid (too few arguments).

example.code:
// Reposition a telop caption
CMND_2DO_POS_SET_TELOP(_name, pose[0], pose[1]);
